why.T3-014: The room sets up a Discord server and moves its canvas planning and live discussion into it, sharing and refreshing invites and sending members there for updates, rather than gathering in a thread or opening a sub.

why.T3-004: The room settles the MIT logo's look: it sets and corrects the corner, debates letter thickness and whitespace, and decides and completes the red dot on the i, working the mark's details out before directions are simply handed out.

why.T3-009: The passages mark the flag work as achieved: praising everyone's work and momentum, calling the teaming-up impressive, and posting the final result, i.e. celebrating the finished collective work.
Members take pride in the small shared mark as achieved: praising the small sub for etching out space and detail and announcing the logo still stands, marking the finished work.

why.T3-033: The room offers and adjusts an idea of what to put on the canvas: circulating a new plan to move the CU logo up, proposing what to go for, and making room in its little spot for the mark.

why.T3-010: The exchanges settle lines and space between neighbouring works with no fight to end: apologising for an overlap, voting to cede territory, agreeing to move or find somewhere else, refusing to move the TARDIS, and seeking a peaceful solution.

why.T3-038: Members build the Villanova logo and report its state: sharing the intended look and what is finished so far, reporting that only the background remains, and redirecting help to the half-built V.

why.T3-002: Short posts call the room's members to come and place for side causes, asking them to join a memorial cause and to help r/FloydVsVoid, recruiting the room to place.

why.T3-137: A member regrets putting their canvas effort into another group's build, r/GreenLattice, instead of the Portuguese mosaic, i.e. joining an outside group's work as their own effort.

why.T3-038: Members place and build the rooster logos and report progress: starting the teeth, working on the rooster above the line and the big black rooster, establishing a square, and calling the logo nearly finished.
why.T3-004: Members settle the mark's colour look, proposing a dark blue surround to make the rooster visible, weighing orange, and settling on lighter blue.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-038 carries the placing and progress reports but not the design decision about the rooster's surround colour that makes the mark visible, which is T3-004's doing

why.T3-010: The room settles lines and space with neighbours: surveying a stable border, striking a deal with RWBY to open borders, moving the subreddit text for Bulgaria, reporting consent to merge borders, and proposing a grey border alliance.

why.T3-001: Members of the sub stage their own new-logo April Fools fake as true and play inside it: announcing the new logo, calling it an early April Fools joke, admitting it got them, hoping it is one, and preserving the reveal for later readers.
